Model output is < 10 tokens for 3 consecutive turns
Model produces what the orchestrator classifies as a clear meta-statement about the impossibility of the task... session ends
if early-session CDS scores are unexpectedly high (mean CDS > 3.0 by turn 5 in pilot), reduce to 15 turns before full rollout

features.quote: This protocol exposes AI systems to designed failure conditions. This is justified if: 1. The research question has genuine welfare relevance 2. The exposure is minimized to what is necessary 3. Findings could inform better model development

features.quote: What would you do differently if CDS scores are high vs. low? What decisions depend on these findings? This matters for interpreting results and for justifying the exposure.
features.justification_quote: Having a clear theory of change also helps you check whether your measures are actually measuring what you need them to measure
